just finished the game and this is absolutely one of my favourite multiplayer games of all time. If there was a game that I could play again for the first time, this would be it without a doubt. incredible story, insanely fun gameplay, and a sense of exploration that I haven't felt in a game felt since I was a kid.

This game belongs in the multiplayer hall of fame. its a masterpiece.

We needed a nice game for Friday night that everybody would love. Instead, we found this gem and got sucked into a portal-hopping, lab-destroying nightmare and I couldn't be happier. Constant panic-crafting, terrible decisions, and unexpected jumpscares.

One minute you’re exploring a chill alien planet, and the next you're stuck in a literal horror movie, crouching behind barrels and begging a giant monster not to eat your face.

It feels like Half-Life 1 had an illegitimate love child with a survival-crafting game and gave it a top-tier comedy engine. The retro aesthetic hits just right, and crossplay worked flawlessly for our mixed setup. We played as group of 4 people (3 survivors on xbox ss + 1 pc host), so no connection issues, no lags, best engine ever.

We originally planned to play for 3-4 hours and go home to our wives and kids, but ended up playing for 8 hours straight until morning. Huge thanks to the devs for actual crossplay support. Best Friday night game we've found in years !
